_note: Reusable state for the Futures Console. Agents update this before rendering each issue. It is a near-term radar of events that could move SP-Index components, not a rumor dump.

radar.title: Google I/O: Gemini Omni / Gemini 4 watch
radar.thesis: Google I/O could move frontier-release velocity if a named model, benchmark table, or product surface ships rather than just being teased.
radar.trigger: Named Gemini release, benchmark table, model card, or public product surface with a clear ship date.

radar.title: Figure F.03 endurance evidence
radar.thesis: The livestream matters if it exposes intervention rate, recovery behavior, or task diversity rather than only stage-managed movement.
radar.trigger: Human-intervention count, recovery failure, hours logged, factory task mix, or new deployment number from Figure.

radar.title: Meta muse-spark identity window
radar.thesis: Anonymous-model movement becomes curve-relevant only if the model resolves to a lab, capability class, and benchmark position.
radar.trigger: Meta announcement, model card, or LMArena identity confirmation for muse-spark-class entries.

radar.title: Anthropic managed agents: preview to GA
radar.thesis: Managed agents only move the autonomy curve if third-party evals or production traces show longer reliable task horizons.
radar.trigger: General availability, pricing, external evals on long-horizon agent tasks, or production case studies with completion-time data.
